message.content: {"verdict":"revise","score":0.58,"reasons":["The artifact mostly follows the required structure but includes a truncation in the theoretical_limits section ('High-concentration multi-junction limits... fo').","One record mislabels device_type as 'dataset' (nrel-chart-2024) which does not match the allowed device_type categories; this should be corrected to a valid type such as 'cell' or 'concentrator cell'."],"guidance":"1) Complete the truncated theoretical_limits entry: finish the sentence and ensure all fields (name, value_percent, assumptions, sources_cited) are present and the JSON is valid. 2) Correct the nrel-chart-2024 record: replace device_type 'dataset' with a valid device_type from the allowed set (e.g., 'cell' or 'concentrator cell'); ensure test_conditions and other fields are appropriate or omit if not applicable. 3) Sanity-check all records for consistency (correct field names, ensure URLs/DOIs exist, verify dates are plausible within ~5-year window). 4) Re-export as research_findings.json with a valid JSON structure."}
